evidence.note: Read the full 983-line CLI entrypoint: subcommand dispatch, hand-rolled flag parsing, envelope emission, and exit-code contract; no eval-style execution, no TODO/FIXME markers, no truncated diff context in the pack.
readCapped enforces byte caps for --data/--input/--goldens/--context and maps overflow to ERR_INPUT_TOO_LARGE; stdin path uses a LimitReader of max+1 so the cap cannot be bypassed.
init refuses a mock scenario directory outside the repo root via relInside before loading it, and rejects duplicate run ids from both runs.jsonl and the run directory.
Untrusted-field marking checked across state/advance/judge/gate/diff envelopes: model-authored and gate-detail strings are consistently listed in untrusted[].
Source change is covered by an existing package test file; go vet on internal/fsm/cli, internal/taskdone, internal/prready is clean.

Reviewed the pr-ready shard wiring tests: they pin write/prune counts, plan-hash agreement with the context pack, rollback on write failure and on review-body failure, chunk-to-file backing, and non-empty real packs.

Reviewed the new task-done shard wiring tests: scope/budget header assertions, plan-hash in the context pack, rollback exactly once on body failure with no housekeeping, prune/gc failures not discarding a recorded run, and Discover called once.

The chmod 0o555 unwritable-directory technique is guarded by t.Skip when the review body still succeeds (e.g. running as root), so the test cannot pass vacuously by asserting on a path that never ran.

Golden prompt fixtures for adjudicate and still-present calibration rendering; they deliberately embed brace and fence sequences to pin injection-resistant templating and contain no executable content.
